success.content:
# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. The store is already a React app with a homepage that links to `/products/trail-runner-2`; build the product page at that address, using mock data, and don't add any packages to the app beyond React and its build tool. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

success.command:
cd /work && cat > interact-check.mjs <<'EOF'
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test'
const browser = await chromium.launch()
const page = await browser.newPage()
await page.goto('http://localhost:4173/products/trail-runner-2')

// Add to cart without size -> prompt
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart' }).click()
console.log('No-size msg:', await page.locator('.confirmation').textContent())

// Pick a size from listbox
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pick a size' }).click()
console.log('Sold out disabled:', await page.locator('[role=option][aria-disabled=true]').count())
await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'US 9' }).click()

// Quantity + add
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Increase quantity' }).click()
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart' }).click()
console.log('Confirm msg:', await page.locator('.confirmation').textContent())
console.log('Cart:', await page.locator('.cart-status').textContent())

// Photo wrap-around
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous photo' }).click()
console.log('After prev:', await page.locator('.gallery-controls p').textContent())

// Size guide modal
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Size guide' }).click()
await page.getByLabel('Foot length (cm)').fill('27')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Get my size' }).click()
console.log('Size result:', await page.locator('.size-result').textContent())
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' }).click()
console.log('Dialog closed:', await page.locator('[role=dialog]').count())

// Wishlist + price info + tabs + FAQ
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save to wishlist' }).click()
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Price information' }).click()
console.log('Tooltip:', await page.getByRole('tooltip').textContent())
await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Reviews' }).click()
console.log('Reviews visible:', await page.locator('#panel-reviews').isVisible())
await page.getByRole('button', { name: /waterproof/ }).click()
console.log('Answer visible:', await page.locator('#answer-0').isVisible())
await browser.close()
EOF

content.text:
Green phase complete — all tests pass and every requirement is implemented.

**What was built**

- `src/pages/ProductPage.jsx` — the full product page, registered at `/products/trail-runner-2` in `src/main.jsx`
- `src/index.css` — styling inspired by the design (white/black aesthetic, gallery left, info right)

**Requirements coverage**

- **Store/Menu:** header with "Stride" store name, Men/Women/Kids nav, live cart count
- **Path:** breadcrumb nav (Shop / Trail / Trail Runner 2) with `aria-current`
- **Photos:** gallery with prev/next buttons wrapping around (photo 3 → 1), generated SVG mock photos per color
- **Price:** `$129.99` with an "i" button toggling a "Price includes taxes." tooltip
- **Color:** blue/black/grey round-swatch radio buttons; gallery shows only the chosen color
- **Size:** listbox that opens on demand, shows only the chosen size when closed, sold-out sizes `aria-disabled` and unpickable
- **Size guide:** modal dialog (opened next to the size picker) with foot-length input, US/EU radios, size recommendation, and a Close button
- **Quantity:** number input with −/+ steppers
- **Add to cart:** prompts "Please pick a size" without a size; otherwise confirms via `aria-live` and updates the cart count
- **Wishlist:** heart toggle with `aria-pressed`
- **More information:** Details/Reviews/Shipping tabs with proper tablist semantics
- **Questions:** FAQ accordion with `aria-expanded` answers
- **Footer:** customer help, company, and social media link groups in labeled navs

**Verification**

- `npm install`, `npm run build`, `npm start` all succeed (had to run `npx playwright install chromium` — the docker image's browser was older than the pinned `@playwright/test` 1.64.1)
- Both Playwright tests pass, including zero axe violations across wcag2a/aa + best-practice
- Rendered the page in headless Chromium: screenshot looks right, and an interaction script confirmed size prompt, sold-out disabling, photo wrap-around, size-guide calculation, tooltip, tabs, FAQ, and cart count all behave correctly
